pageUrls.title: Facebook business page URLs
pageUrls.description: One or more Facebook business page URLs. Example: https://www.facebook.com/InNOut/reviews

pageUrl.title: Single page URL (alternative)
pageUrl.description: Single Facebook business page URL. Used only if pageUrls is empty.

maxReviews.title: Maximum reviews to extract
maxReviews.description: Hard cap per business page. Prevents runaway charges on pages with thousands of reviews.

loginCookies.title: Facebook login cookies (JSON array)
loginCookies.description: Paste your Facebook cookies as a JSON array. Facebook requires login to view reviews. Export cookies using a browser extension like EditThisCookie or Cookie-Editor.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Facebook blocks datacenter IPs. Use residential proxies if you see login challenges.
